title: Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted

translated_title: 规则可摊销，配对不可摊销：语言结构决定哪些潜在任务表征能够替代上下文学习
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）可以被摊销为潜在对象（任务向量、函数向量、上下文向量），这些对象能以零样本推理成本恢复少样本行为，但近期的理论表明，静态向量只相当于单个合成演示，在诸如词级双射这样的高秩映射上必然失败。我们提出了这一问题的语言学版本：哪些语言操作可以从提示中被摊销出来？我们训练了一个260万参数的网络，它读取少样本支持集的几何结构（质心、主子空间、谱，只需计算一次并缓存），并在冻结的GPT-2-large/XL模型的中间深度层对查询的残差流产生输入条件化的加性更新。在八个屈折变化方向和一个词汇关系上，在禁止方向间倒置对信息泄漏的规范数据划分下，出现了三种机制。在前向屈折上，10-shot ICL表现较强（0.67–0.89），提取的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现语言结构决定了哪些潜在任务表征能够替代上下文学习——规则性语言操作（如前向屈折变化）可以被动态的几何潜在向量摊销，而任意词对配对映射则无法被摊销。
en_tdlr: Linguistic structure determines which latent task representations can replace in-context learning: rule-based operations (e.g., forward inflection) can be amortized into input-conditioned geometric latent vectors, while arbitrary word pairings cannot.
